summary: Three-bedroom, two-bath home in South Salinas with a pool, a fireplace, and a well-equipped kitchen.

about.title: A South Salinas home with a pool
about.lead: A three-bedroom, two-bath single-family home in the College Manor neighborhood of South Salinas, with a private pool in the back yard.
paragraphs: The living room is spacious and centered on a fireplace. The kitchen has a built-in oven, a built-in microwave, an electric cooktop, and plenty of counter space and cabinet storage.
more: There are three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a hall bath with a tub and shower.
Out back, the pool makes the yard a place to spend warm afternoons and evenings.
highlights: Plenty of counter and storage space

locationText: In the College Manor neighborhood of South Salinas, Monterey County.
factsNote: Square footage and year built are from public records and have not been independently measured.
